name: The Anchor
fieldReading: Hold your ground, and others are free to lose theirs.
bio: The steady weight the night orbits — calm, unhurried, fully present. Where they stand, other people find their feet.
sceneStory: A wide river of liquid light pours across the frame, sweeping loose stars and tumbling figures along in its current. Braced dead-center against the flow, a figure grips a taut chain running down to a massive iron anchor buried in the glowing riverbed, the rushing light splitting into two smooth curves around their planted boots.
assignment: Be the still point the night turns around. People let go only where someone else is holding on.
